about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-cis80 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.evidence: source: "You can use the blank template on page 2 to record your plan." / tree: "to record your plan. present do you have? This guidance is issued by the Health and Safety Executive."

findings.problem: The page number is kept at the end of the closing paragraph.
findings.evidence: source: "for a free smartphone app CDM wizard." / tree: "for a free smartphone app CDM wizard. 1"

findings.problem: The plan template is a table but is read as running text, so each hazard heading is joined to the end of the bullet above it.
findings.evidence: source: "Collapse of excavations" (row heading) / tree: "using guardrails, midrails and toeboards Collapse of excavations"

findings.problem: The two column headings of the hazard table are run together and their second halves are moved into another section.
